name: fund.heimdall/mcp
title: Heimdall Shield
description: Firewall for AI agents on Robinhood Chain: check transactions and signatures before signing.

environmentVariables.name: HEIMDALL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shield API key. Optional: without one the free tier applies.

environmentVariables.name: HEIMDALL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Shield API base URL. Defaults to the public Heimdall API.

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Robinhood Chain RPC used for onchain reads.

environmentVariables.name: HEIMDALL_PAY_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: HeimdallPay contract, for the Pay tools. Defaults to the Heimdall mainnet deployment.

environmentVariables.name: HEIMDALL_FACTORY_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: HeimdallVaultFactory, for the vault tools. Defaults to the Heimdall mainnet deployment.

environmentVariables.name: HEIMDALL_SIGNALS_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: HeimdallSignals, for the signal tools. Defaults to the Heimdall mainnet deployment.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <Heimdall API key> lifts the free-tier limit
